text: One design remedy for thin trading volume is supervision of digital asset exchanges by a federal governing authority or a self regulatory organization to assure compliance with existing laws.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Samuel Evans, Hayley Howe, Digital Asset Valuation (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4033886
abstract: To increase the trading volume, one solution may be to have a federal governing authority or a self-regulatory organization monitor the exchange to assure compliance with existing laws.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: digital asset exchanges operating under legal uncertainty
